failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All 19 PyTorch Detectron2 precommit model conversion tests fail while downloading model weights from an upstream host whose TLS certificate has expired

key_errors: E           URLError: <urlopen error [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: certificate has expired (_ssl.c:1018)>
Attempt 1 of 3 failed: <urlopen error [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: certificate has expired (_ssl.c:1018)>
root_cause: The Detectron2 model-hub precommit tests download pretrained weight checkpoints over HTTPS from an external host (dl.fbaipublicfiles.com) via detectron2's DetectionCheckpointer -> iopath download() path. The remote host's TLS certificate has expired, so every HTTPS connection now fails Python's certificate validation with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED, causing all parametrized Detectron2 conversion tests to fail identically (download is a prerequisite step, unrelated to the PR's actual diff). This is the third observed occurrence of this exact signature within the last ~2 hours, confirming it is an ongoing external-service outage rather than a one-off blip.
reproduction_steps: Run `pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_detectron2.py::TestDetectron2ConvertModel::test_detectron2_precommit` locally with network access; the download of any Detectron2 COCO/Cityscapes/LVIS checkpoint from dl.fbaipublicfiles.com will fail with the same SSL certificate-expired error until the upstream certificate is renewed.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed jobs once the upstream certificate is renewed (expected to self-resolve; this is not fixable from the OpenVINO repo).
Consider mirroring/caching Detectron2 model weights in an internal artifact store to decouple precommit CI from this third-party host's certificate lifecycle.
If the outage persists beyond a few hours, mark the detectron2 precommit tests as xfail/skip temporarily with a tracking ticket to unblock the merge queue.
prevention_strategies: Avoid hard dependencies on third-party HTTPS hosts for precommit-blocking tests; cache or vendor model weights, or add a short retry-with-backoff plus a clear xfail marker keyed to this specific SSL error so a recurring external outage doesn't repeatedly block merges.
historical_context: This exact failure signature (signature_hash 2641a2995515ec82) was first recorded at 2026-11-12T01:09:15Z (run 43121154399, PR #39727) and recurred at 2026-11-12T02:34:24Z (run 43133112821, PR #39727); this is the 3rd occurrence within the last 12 hours, now also affecting PR #38204, confirming a sustained upstream TLS outage rather than an isolated flake.
